item.title: Notebookcheck: Smartwatch with OLED display in brass frame costs tinkerers less than $10
item.description: The components that make up a smartwatch can be bought for just a few bucks. This is demonstrated by a new DIY project that packs a smartwatch with an ESP32 board and OLED display into a brass frame, all for under $10.

item.title: Notebookcheck: Edifier launches new open-ear clip-on earbuds with LDAC support, Bluetooth 6.1, and 44 hours of battery life
item.description: Edifier has launched the Sona Clip as its latest pair of open-ear earbuds with a clip-on design. Boasting support for Hi-Res Wireless Audio, LDAC, Bluetooth 6.1, and a 44-hour battery life, the earbuds will be sold in China for the equivalent of $70.
